items.quoteFR: Mamadou delivered our mobile payment platform in record time. His microservices architecture with Keycloak solved our security challenges from day one. A developer who truly understands African business realities.

Perfect remote collaboration. Mamadou integrates feedback quickly, his code is clean and well-documented. He hit the ground running on our Spring Boot / Angular stack with zero hand-holding from our side.

We brought Mamadou in to overhaul our internal management system. He proposed a clear architecture, set up CI/CD with Jenkins and Docker, and trained our team. Very professional, punctual, and genuinely responsive.
The PWA app Mamadou built works offline in our rural areas — that was our core constraint. He perfectly understood the local context and delivered something we didn't expect to afford at this budget.
